item.title: Osaka Noodles Guide: Kitsune Udon, Kasuudon & Local Ramen
item.description: Osaka is a noodle city, and its signature is udon — soft, slippery wheat noodles in a pale, kelp-and-light-soy dashi that’s gentler and more delicate than Tokyo’s dark broth. This is the birthplace of kitsune udon, the beloved bowl topped with sweet fried tofu, and home to its own quirky specialities like kasuudon. Alongside udon you’ll find rich local ramen, griddle-fried yakisoba, and the late-night noodle shops that keep Osaka fed.
